interpretation.authoritative_representation: This JSON is the machine-readable authority for the closure assessment. The paired Markdown file is a human-readable projection and must not be used to claim a gate passed.
interpretation.evidence_boundary: Preparation records requirements and observed absence only. It is not a corpus manifest, benchmark result, approval, review, audit pack, release record, or owner decision.
interpretation.fail_closed_rule: NOT_RUN, BLOCKED, RESERVED_EXTERNAL, missing, stale, or unverified evidence is a release blocker and never a PASS.
interpretation.external_record_rule: Identities, dispositions, provider runs, corpus rights, independent oracle results, hosted checks, review decisions, and owner approval must come from immutable external PR or workflow records when the frozen task requires them.
interpretation.rerun_rule: When external evidence arrives, update only the evidence records and this assessment on the new exact head; do not change specs/008-swos-v2-research-grade/tasks.md except permitted completion markers.
